<div class="function-explorer">

::: {.callout-note}
## Explore reporting functions

1. Search by function name, description, or keyword.
2. Filter by the fields available in your cleaned dataset, language, or output type.
3. Select **View details** to inspect requirements, attribution, and a sample output.
4. Follow the GitHub Issue link to review build history or contribute another language version.
:::

## Find a function

<div class="function-explorer__filters">

<div class="function-explorer__search">

```{ojs}
viewof function_explorer_search = Inputs.text({
  label: "Keyword search",
  placeholder: "Search titles, descriptions, or keywords"
})
```

</div>

```{ojs}
function_explorer_registry = JSON.parse(
  await FileAttachment("functions/registry.json").text()
)

function_explorer_standard_fields = [
  "latitude",
  "longitude",
  "time",
  "depth",
  "temperature",
  "salinity",
  "density",
  "oxygen"
]

function_explorer_chip_input = (
  options,
  {label, multiple = false, value, modifier}
) => {
  const form = function_explorer_element(
    "form",
    `function-explorer__filter-card function-explorer__chip-filter function-explorer__chip-filter--${modifier}`
  );
  const fieldset = function_explorer_element("fieldset", "");
  const legend = function_explorer_element("legend", "", label);
  const chips = function_explorer_element("div", "function-explorer__chips");
  let selected = multiple ? [...value] : value;

  const update = () => {
    for (const button of chips.querySelectorAll("button")) {
      const active = multiple
        ? selected.includes(button.value)
        : selected === button.value;
      button.classList.toggle("function-explorer__chip--active", active);
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(active));
    }
    form.value = multiple ? [...selected] : selected;
  };

  for (const option of options) {
    const button = function_explorer_element(
      "button",
      "function-explorer__chip",
      option
    );
    button.type = "button";
    button.value = option;
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (multiple) {
        selected = selected.includes(option)
          ? selected.filter((item) => item !== option)
          : [...selected, option];
      } else {
        selected = option;
      }
      update();
      form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
    });
    chips.append(button);
  }

  fieldset.append(legend, chips);
  form.append(fieldset);
  update();
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof function_explorer_required_fields = function_explorer_chip_input(
  function_explorer_standard_fields,
  {label: "Required fields", multiple: true, value: [], modifier: "fields"}
)
```

```{ojs}
viewof function_explorer_language = function_explorer_chip_input(
  ["All", "R", "Python", "Quarto", "MATLAB", "Julia", "Pseudo-code"],
  {label: "Language", value: "All", modifier: "language"}
)
```

```{ojs}
viewof function_explorer_output_type = function_explorer_chip_input(
  ["All", "Figure/Plot", "Table", "Summary Text"],
  {label: "Output type", value: "All", modifier: "output"}
)
```

</div>

```{ojs}
function_explorer_matches = {
  const query = function_explorer_search.trim().toLowerCase();
  const selectedFields = function_explorer_required_fields || [];

  return function_explorer_registry.filter((entry) => {
    const searchableText = [
      entry.name,
      entry.description,
      ...(entry.keywords || [])
    ].join(" ").toLowerCase();
    const requiredFields = entry.required_fields || [];

    return (!query || searchableText.includes(query))
      && selectedFields.every((field) => requiredFields.includes(field))
      && (function_explorer_language === "All"
        || entry.language === function_explorer_language)
      && (function_explorer_output_type === "All"
        || entry.output_type === function_explorer_output_type);
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
function_explorer_element = (tagName, className, text) => {
  const element = document.createElement(tagName);
  if (className) element.className = className;
  if (text !== undefined) element.textContent = text;
  return element;
}

function_explorer_issue_link = (entry, className, text) => {
  const link = function_explorer_element(
    "a",
    className,
    text
  );
  link.href = entry.issue_url;
  link.target = "_blank";
  link.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
  return link;
}

function_explorer_tag = (text, modifier = "") => function_explorer_element(
  "span",
  `function-explorer__tag${modifier ? ` ${modifier}` : ""}`,
  text
)
```

## Available functions

```{ojs}
function_explorer_catalog = {
  const catalog = function_explorer_element("section", "function-explorer__catalog");
  const resultLabel = function_explorer_element(
    "p",
    "function-explorer__result-count",
    `${function_explorer_matches.length} function${function_explorer_matches.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} found`
  );
  resultLabel.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
  catalog.append(resultLabel);

  if (function_explorer_matches.length === 0) {
    catalog.append(function_explorer_element(
      "p",
      "function-explorer__empty",
      "No functions match these filters. Try removing a filter or using a broader search."
    ));
    return catalog;
  }

  const grid = function_explorer_element("div", "function-explorer__grid");
  const overlay = function_explorer_element("div", "function-explorer__overlay");
  const drawer = function_explorer_element("aside", "function-explorer__drawer");
  drawer.setAttribute("role", "dialog");
  drawer.setAttribute("aria-modal", "true");
  drawer.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  drawer.setAttribute("aria-label", "Function details");
  overlay.hidden = true;
  drawer.hidden = true;

  const closeDrawer = () => {
    overlay.hidden = true;
    drawer.hidden = true;
    drawer.classList.remove("function-explorer__drawer--open");
    drawer.classList.remove("function-explorer__drawer--full-screen");
    drawer.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  };

  const openDrawer = (entry) => {
    drawer.replaceChildren();

    const header = function_explorer_element(
      "header",
      "function-explorer__drawer-header"
    );
    const closeButton = function_explorer_element(
      "button",
      "function-explorer__drawer-close",
      "Close (✕)"
    );
    closeButton.type = "button";
    closeButton.setAttribute("aria-label", "Close function details");
    closeButton.addEventListener("click", closeDrawer);

    const expandButton = function_explorer_element(
      "button",
      "function-explorer__drawer-expand",
      "Expand Full Screen"
    );
    expandButton.type = "button";
    expandButton.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
    expandButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const expanded = drawer.classList.toggle(
        "function-explorer__drawer--full-screen"
      );
      expandButton.textContent = expanded ? "Normal View" : "Expand Full Screen";
      expandButton.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(expanded));
    });

    const title = function_explorer_element("h2", "", entry.name);
    const headerControls = function_explorer_element(
      "div",
      "function-explorer__drawer-controls"
    );
    headerControls.append(expandButton, closeButton);
    header.append(title, headerControls);
    const body = function_explorer_element("div", "function-explorer__drawer-body");
    const tags = function_explorer_element("div", "function-explorer__tags");
    tags.append(
      function_explorer_tag(entry.language),
      function_explorer_tag(
        entry.translation_status === "ready" ? "Ready" : "Needs translation",
        entry.translation_status === "ready"
          ? "function-explorer__tag--ready"
          : "function-explorer__tag--translation"
      ),
      function_explorer_tag(entry.output_type)
    );

    const descriptionHeading = function_explorer_element("h3", "", "Description");
    const description = function_explorer_element("p", "", entry.description);
    const requirementsHeading = function_explorer_element(
      "h3",
      "",
      "Operational requirements"
    );
    const requirements = function_explorer_element("p", "");
    requirements.append("Implementation: ", function_explorer_element(
      "code",
      "",
      entry.code_file
    ));

    const fieldsHeading = function_explorer_element("h3", "", "Required input fields");
    const fieldList = function_explorer_element("ul", "function-explorer__field-list");
    for (const field of entry.required_fields || []) {
      fieldList.append(function_explorer_element("li", "", field));
    }

    const previewHeading = function_explorer_element("h3", "", "Sample output");
    const preview = document.createElement("img");
    preview.className = "function-explorer__preview";
    preview.src = `data/precomputed_outputs/${encodeURIComponent(entry.id)}.png`;
    preview.alt = `Pre-computed sample output for ${entry.name}`;
    preview.loading = "lazy";
    const previewUnavailable = function_explorer_element(
      "p",
      "function-explorer__preview-unavailable",
      "A pre-computed preview is not available for this function."
    );
    previewUnavailable.hidden = true;
    preview.addEventListener("error", () => {
      preview.hidden = true;
      previewUnavailable.hidden = false;
    });

    const citationHeading = function_explorer_element(
      "h3",
      "",
      "Citation & methodology"
    );
    const citation = function_explorer_element(
      "p",
      "function-explorer__citation",
      entry.citation || "No citation supplied."
    );

    body.append(
      tags,
      descriptionHeading,
      description,
      requirementsHeading,
      requirements,
      fieldsHeading,
      fieldList,
      previewHeading,
      preview,
      previewUnavailable,
      citationHeading,
      citation
    );

    const footer = function_explorer_element(
      "footer",
      "function-explorer__drawer-footer"
    );
    const footerCloseButton = function_explorer_element(
      "button",
      "function-explorer__drawer-close",
      "Close (✕)"
    );
    footerCloseButton.type = "button";
    footerCloseButton.addEventListener("click", closeDrawer);
    footer.append(
      function_explorer_issue_link(
        entry,
        "function-explorer__issue-link",
        "View Build History on GitHub"
      ),
      footerCloseButton
    );
    drawer.append(header, body, footer);
    overlay.hidden = false;
    drawer.hidden = false;
    drawer.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      drawer.classList.add("function-explorer__drawer--open");
      closeButton.focus();
    });
  };

  overlay.addEventListener("click", closeDrawer);
  drawer.addEventListener("click", (event) => event.stopPropagation());
  const closeOnEscape = (event) => {
    if (event.key === "Escape" && !drawer.hidden) closeDrawer();
  };
  document.addEventListener("keydown", closeOnEscape);
  invalidation.then(() => document.removeEventListener("keydown", closeOnEscape));

  for (const entry of function_explorer_matches) {
    const card = function_explorer_element("article", "function-explorer__card");
    const title = function_explorer_element("h3", "", entry.name);
    const description = function_explorer_element("p", "", entry.description);
    const tags = function_explorer_element("div", "function-explorer__tags");
    tags.append(
      function_explorer_tag(entry.language),
      function_explorer_tag(
        entry.translation_status === "ready" ? "Ready" : "Needs translation",
        entry.translation_status === "ready"
          ? "function-explorer__tag--ready"
          : "function-explorer__tag--translation"
      )
    );

    const detailsButton = function_explorer_element(
      "button",
      "function-explorer__details-button",
      "View details"
    );
    detailsButton.type = "button";
    detailsButton.addEventListener("click", () => openDrawer(entry));

    card.append(
      title,
      description,
      tags,
      detailsButton
    );
    grid.append(card);
  }

  catalog.append(grid, overlay, drawer);
  return catalog;
}
```

</div>
